01 / READ CSV

Choose your crawl CSV

Screaming Frog: English Internal → All → Export, UTF-8 comma-separated CSV. Compatible schemas also work.

Up to 5,000 URLs and 5 MB per file. Required columns: Address, Status Code. Same crawl settings recommended.

No data imported. Try the sample to see the workflow.
Supported columns and limits

Optional: Content Type (or Content), Title 1, Meta Description 1, H1-1, Indexability Status. Missing columns disable those checks. No live crawling, ranking advice, JavaScript rendering or full SEO audit. XLSX, semicolon CSV and localized headers are not supported.

URLs and query strings remain in exported reports. Review them before sharing. Closing or reloading this page clears your work.
